beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: As Jesus traveled toward Jerusalem, a Samaritan village refused to welcome Him. The disciples James and John were hot with anger.

timing.text: As Jesus traveled toward Jerusalem, a Samaritan village refused to welcome Him.
The disciples James and John were hot with anger.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

timing.text: Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: They asked if they should call down fire from heaven to burn the place. They wanted judgment.

timing.text: They asked if they should call down fire from heaven to burn the place.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Jesus turned and rebuked them — not the village, but His own disciples' hearts.

timing.text: Jesus turned and rebuked them — not the village, but His own disciples' hearts.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of. For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.

timing.text: Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He didn't come to burn. He came to rescue. The fire in the disciples' hearts was the wrong kind.

timing.text: The fire in the disciples' hearts was the wrong kind.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And then they simply walked on to the next village. No fire. No answer to the insult at all — just the road, and somewhere else to be.

timing.text: And then they simply walked on to the next village.
No answer to the insult at all — just the road, and somewhere else to be.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Anger that wants to destroy isn't from Him. The spirit He brings saves.

timing.text: Anger that wants to destroy isn't from Him.

card.text: He came to save, not to burn. Let His Spirit — the saving one — shape yours.
